lines.en: I stride on two thick legs.
Doorways would have to be widened for me.
My arms swing as I go.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩出浅浅的坑。
lines.en: Each step presses a shallow pit.
I move through the conifers.

lines.zh: 我从黑森林的树间挤过。
lines.en: I squeeze between the dark forest trees.
My tail sways along behind me.
I do not hurry, but I am strong.
I turn slowly, shoulders first.

lines.zh: 我的脚步让雪都陷下去。
lines.en: My steps sink the snow.

lines.zh: 我沿着黑森林的边线走。
lines.en: I walk the dark forest's edge.
I stop and check the way.
My fists are half closed.
I step through a fallen log.
I stand, my chest rising and falling.
I am looking at my fists.
There is no opponent in this wood.
I roll my shoulders slowly.
The snow smells sharp with pine resin.
I wait for a fight worth having.
I stay still, muscles tight.
Every breath sits heavy in my lungs.
The snow on the ground is melting.
I glance at the treetops.
I take my stand by the stump.
I shift onto the other foot and roll my ankle.

lines.zh: 我看看自己的影子有多宽
lines.en: I check how wide my shadow falls.
I crack my knuckles.
You look like you can fight.

lines.zh: 我先看你的脚，再看你的手
lines.en: I look at your feet first, then your hands.
Your stance is not bad.
You smell of training.
I am waiting for an opponent.
You don't even reach my chin.
I lift my chin and wait for you to speak.
Your hands shake like a sieve.
Want to try my fist?
This fist of mine can break stone.

lines.zh: 你站进我的拳头范围了。
lines.en: You are inside my reach.
Your kind doesn't bother me.
You have strength; I can tell.
Your armor is not sound.
I wait for you to set your stance.
Your eyes are steady.
That punch actually had some weight to it.
I step back and hold.
It hurts, but my hide is thick.
My shoulder is a little numb.

lines.zh: 这一拳，连我的肌肉都震麻。
lines.en: That punch even left my muscles numb.
That put some fire in me.
I can fight on.
My blood is on the snow.
My fist tightens until the knuckles whiten.
Then come again.
Smell of meat? Give it here.

lines.zh: 那股肉味把我拽了过去
lines.en: That meat smell drags me over.

lines.zh: 这么一点，塞我牙缝都不够
lines.en: That little? Not even enough for my teeth.
You are holding it too low.
I snatch it over.
This has some chew to it.
Three bites and the chunk is gone.
More; I have not eaten enough.
The smell is on your hands too.
I will talk after I eat.
If it's meat, I'll eat it.
Step back; I will eat.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我胸肌把你弹回
lines.en: You crash in and my chest springs you back.
I stand like a wall and don't budge.
That should leave your shoulder sore.

lines.zh: 我这身肌肉不是摆着看的。
lines.en: This muscle is not for show.
Snow sprays where we meet.

lines.zh: 你退开了，我连脚都没挪
lines.en: You back off and I haven't moved a foot.
I raise a forearm across.
You lean on me like a little heater.
Do not hit my chest.
Good; we each step back.
I think only of getting stronger.

lines.zh: 这副身体是为战斗长的。
lines.en: This body grew for fighting.

lines.zh: 同心圆的世界里没这回事。
lines.en: That is not how this world works.
You do not sound like a tamer.
That's not for me. I shake my head.
I want to evolve, not that.
I do not know this subject.
After I win, perhaps.
I turn and roll my shoulder.
Do not waste time.
I reach down and close my hand on it.
It is tiny in my fist.
I squeeze once; it holds.
I toss it back at your feet.
This has no weight.

lines.zh: 我两根指头就把它夹住
lines.en: Two fingers are enough to pinch it.
It is stuck between my fingers.
I look at it and drop it.
It smells of me now.
Good; I have it.
I hear something coming.
I have framed my target.
I bring my fist up beside my ear.

lines.zh: 这一带的雪很适合开打。
lines.en: The snow here is good for a fight.
I hold still and let you swing first.
My shoulder is already turned.
It has stopped; good.
I drop my weight and move in.
There is ferocity in the air.
Stand ready. Here we go.
I drop my weight below my hips.

lines.zh: 你的左肩空着，我看见了
lines.en: Your left shoulder is open. I see it.
I circle the tree after it.

lines.zh: 它的脚印一串，我跟着走
lines.en: Its prints run in a line and I follow.
I need not run; I can reach.
I turn my shoulder to it.
It retreats and I take a step.
I count its rhythm.
I took a blow and did not fall.
Its breathing has gone ragged.

lines.zh: 我一寸一寸把距离吃掉
lines.en: I eat up the distance inch by inch.
The distance is right now.
I raise both fists.
It turns its back to me. Perfect.
My fist comes down from the shoulder.
The punch blows the snow aside.
The blow knocked you back.
A straight punch follows it up.

lines.zh: 你砍在我的手臂上，很浅。
lines.en: You cut my arm; the wound is shallow.

lines.zh: 我揪住你的护肩往回带
lines.en: I grab your pauldron and pull you in.

lines.zh: 这一下带着我全身的力。
lines.en: That carried my whole weight.

lines.zh: 地面的雪被我们踩实了。
lines.en: The snow is packed where we fought.
You fall into the snow.
After that punch my chest burns.

lines.zh: 你还敢站，我倒有点欣赏
lines.en: You still stand. I respect that a little.
I raise a hand to press again.

lines.zh: 我被放在黑森林的雪地上。
lines.en: I am set down in the dark forest snow.
My health is rolling.
First I roll my shoulders.
The trees are dense here; no room.
The snow is deep and soft.
I stride toward the clearing.

lines.zh: 雪那边有脚步，我听见了
lines.en: Footsteps past the snow. I hear them.
I clench my fists to test my strength.

lines.zh: 我呼出的白气一团团散开
lines.en: Each breath I blow out blooms into mist.
I stand tall and level my shoulders.
Good; first, somewhere to drill.
I crunch through a dead branch.

lines.zh: 我在雪上投下一大块黑影
lines.en: I throw a big dark block of shadow on the snow.
I look toward the sound.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的手臂，我甩了甩。
lines.en: Fire catches my arm; I shake it.

lines.zh: 我从坡上砸下，蹲了一下。
lines.en: I crash off the slope and crouch.

lines.zh: 水没到我胸口，我抬头喘。
lines.en: Water reaches my chest; I gasp upward.
The blast throws me against a tree.
An arrow sticks in my shoulder, shallow.

lines.zh: 那股力量钻进我的肌肉。
lines.en: That force works into my muscles.
No meat, and my fists soften.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我背上，整条脊都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning hits my back and my whole spine numbs.
I fall, arms swinging at nothing.
